integrity: The proof establishes the infinite assertion analytically; verify.py supplies exact finite algebraic cross-checks only. No third-party full text is embedded.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns stationary finite-state irreducible aperiodic Markov break sequences with values bounded away from zero and one. It does not establish a finite-sample variance asymptotic, quantitative CLT rate, or posterior inference theorem. Historical priority relative to general stationary-frequency occupancy results remains provisional.
title: Functional diversity limit for finite-state Markov stick breaking
